description: A zone of the router's firewall: interfaces and VRFs whose connections the FirewallPolicy documents treat alike. The zone local is the router itself and has no document.

interfaces.description: Interfaces of the zone, by name or glob, a glob being a prefix followed by `*`. A link a VRF holds may be named here without its VRF, so that one VRF's links fall into several zones; it is then in no other zone through its VRF.

vrfs.description: VRF documents whose links are all in the zone, those added later included; a VRF is in one zone at most.

title: FirewallZone

rules.description: No FirewallZone is named local, the router itself.
rules.message: a FirewallZone is named local, which is the router itself: FirewallPolicy documents name it without a document, so give the zone another name

rules.description: An interface or glob is in one FirewallZone, once; globs compare as written.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(all, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.interfaces).flatten(), "the interface " + all.filter(i, size(all.filter(j, j == i)) > 1)[0] + " is in more than one FirewallZone, or twice in one; give each interface one zone")
rules.rule: cel.bind(all, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.interfaces).flatten(), all.all(i, size(all.filter(j, j == i)) == 1))

rules.description: A FirewallZone names an interface or a VRF.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, size(documents[n].spec.interfaces) == 0 && size(documents[n].spec.vrfs) == 0).map(n, "FirewallZone " + n).join(", ") + " names no interface and no VRF; give it interfaces, vrfs or both"

rules.description: A FirewallZone's VRFs are VRF documents.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(vrfs, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "VRF" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].VRF : {}), cel.bind(all, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.vrfs).flatten(), cel.bind(v, all.filter(v, !(v in vrfs))[0], "FirewallZone " + documents.filter(n, v in documents[n].spec.vrfs)[0] + " names the VRF " + v + ", which no VRF document declares")))
rules.rule: cel.bind(vrfs, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "VRF" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].VRF : {}), cel.bind(all, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.vrfs).flatten(), all.all(v, v in vrfs)))

rules.description: A VRF is in one FirewallZone, once.
rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(all, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.vrfs).flatten(), "the VRF " + all.filter(v, size(all.filter(w, w == v)) > 1)[0] + " is in more than one FirewallZone, or twice in one; give each VRF one zone")
rules.rule: cel.bind(all, documents.map(n, documents[n].spec.vrfs).flatten(), all.all(v, size(all.filter(w, w == v)) == 1))
